headline: Zomato acquires Uber Eats India
summary: All-stock deal: Uber received a 9.99% stake in Zomato in exchange for its Indian food delivery business, removing a well-funded competitor.

headline: Zomato acquires Blinkit (formerly Grofers)
summary: All-stock acquisition of the quick-commerce company Blinkit, which became Zomato's main growth engine.

headline: Zomato buys Paytm's entertainment ticketing business
summary: Cash acquisition of Paytm Insider and TicketNew, forming the base of Zomato's 'District' going-out app.

headline: Zomato raises Rs 8,500 crore through a QIP
summary: Qualified institutional placement to strengthen the balance sheet amid quick-commerce competition.

headline: Swiggy acquires Dineout from Times Internet
summary: Acquisition of the restaurant discovery and table-booking platform, taking Swiggy into dine-out alongside delivery.

headline: Swiggy lists on NSE and BSE after Rs 11,327 crore IPO
summary: One of India's largest internet IPOs, combining a fresh issue with an offer for sale by early investors.

headline: FSN E-Commerce (Nykaa) lists after Rs 5,352 crore IPO
summary: Listed at a large premium, becoming one of the first profitable new-age tech companies to list in India.

headline: PB Fintech (PolicyBazaar) lists after Rs 5,710 crore IPO
summary: IPO of the insurance and credit marketplace operator behind PolicyBazaar and Paisabazaar.

headline: HDFC Bank announces merger with parent HDFC Ltd
summary: Reverse merger of India's largest housing finance company into its banking subsidiary, creating one of the world's most valuable banks.

merger.swap_ratio: 42 HDFC Bank shares for 25 HDFC shares

headline: Axis Bank to acquire Citibank's India consumer business
summary: Cash acquisition of Citi's Indian credit cards, retail banking, wealth and consumer loans businesses as Citi exited consumer banking in India.

headline: ICICI Bank board approves delisting of ICICI Securities via share swap
summary: ICICI Securities to become a wholly owned subsidiary; public shareholders receive ICICI Bank shares. Completed in March 2025.

merger.swap_ratio: 67 ICICI Bank shares for 100 ICICI Securities shares

headline: L&T Infotech and Mindtree announce merger to form LTIMindtree
summary: Merger of two L&T group IT services companies; the combined entity later renamed itself LTM Limited in 2026.

headline: Wipro to acquire Capco for USD 1.45 billion
summary: Wipro's largest acquisition: a London-based consultancy serving banks and financial services firms.

headline: Coforge to acquire a majority stake in Cigniti Technologies
summary: Acquisition of up to 54% of the digital assurance and testing firm, via share purchases and an open offer.
